projectDescription: A research jailbreak toolkit for iPhone 11 Pro (A13/T8030) using the usbliter8 SecureROM exploit to build and restore a custom firmware on iOS 27 beta.
keyFeatures: SecureROM exploit (usbliter8) via RP2350/Raspberry Pi Pico 2 to enter PWN DFU mode
Custom firmware (CFW) builder targeting iPhone 11 Pro (iPhone12,3) on iOS 27.0 beta
Kernel patches: SSV bypass, AMFI/TrustCache, launch constraints, USB Restricted Mode
Userland byte-patcher for coreauthd, ctkd, and mobileactivationd (hacktivation)
ScreenTime/launchd override to skip Setup deadlock
Reverse USB tethering (net_up.sh) to share Mac internet over USB-ethernet
SSH ramdisk (SSHRD) boot chain for filesystem access and patching
TrollVNC integration for screen control over USB
TSS proxy server for signing beta firmware with Apple's ticket server
Bootstrap and Sileo package manager installation support
publicApiSurface: make_cfw.py — build the custom firmware and restore ramdisk
restore_cfw.sh — flash CFW to device via idevicerestore
boot.py — send normal boot chain to device via usbliter8ctl + irecovery
boot_rd.sh — send SSHRD boot chain to device
get_boot.py — build/refresh the normal boot Ramdisk chain
get_fw.py — download and extract the IPSW firmware
tss_proxy_server.py — local HTTP proxy for TSS signing requests
net_up.sh — set up reverse USB tethering from Mac to device
vnc_up.sh — start TrollVNC server and open screen sharing
tools/usbliter8ctl — send iBSS/exploit payload over USB
tools/ldid_macosx_arm64 — re-sign binaries with ad-hoc entitlements
